Schiff Disputes Trump’s Factory Boom Claims
On Saturday, in a post on
the veteran investor disputed Trump’s assertion that thousands of manufacturing plants are under construction because of his tariff policies.
“Trump claims that because of his tariffs, thousands of manufacturing plants are under construction. Not true,” Schiff wrote.
He cited Census Bureau data showing private manufacturing construction spending fell 21.7% in the first nine months of 2026 compared with the same period a year earlier.
Spending on computer, electronic and electrical manufacturing construction fell even more sharply, dropping 45% over the same period.
